title: WAGO PFC200
summary: Compact DIN-rail controllers with WAGO I/O System 750 modules.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: I/O modules snap onto the controller and form the local bus; power supply modules feed potential groups.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: No simulation profile; use the `generic.iec` profile. Modules with their own field supply appear in the Hardware tab, and a missing load supply is practiced in the lab `ts.outputs-dead`. **CONCEPTUAL**.
